en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate, ivy‑covered hillside villa or small palace in eclectic neo‑Gothic/romantic style, with towers, arched loggias, decorative roof patterns, and statues (including a winged figure on a dome). In the foreground stands a simpler rectangular building with arched windows and a hipped roof, partially obscured by trees. Forested hills rise behind the main villa.
